fee_notes: Royalty is 25% of Gross Sales for the first 7 months; beginning month 8, the greater of 25% of Gross Sales or applicable minimum monthly amounts (see Note 3 in source). Renewing franchisees subject to 5th-year minimum royalty requirements throughout renewal term. Royalties are collected by franchisor directly from customers via website; Net Proceeds distributed weekly (currently Fridays). Marketing Fund: greater of 0.5% of monthly Gross Sales or $50/month in months 1-12 and $100/month thereafter; currently capped at maximum of 2% of Gross Sales. Local marketing spend minimums also required: $300 in year 1, $500 in months 13-24, $800 per 12-month period thereafter, plus at least 24 promotional yard greeting services per 12-month period. Late fee: 18% per annum or maximum legal rate, or at franchisor's option $100 per late payment. Additional training at franchisor's option: $150/day per trainer.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty Fee An amount equal to 25% of your Gross Sales during the first seven months following the Effective Date of your Franchise Agreement. Beginning in your eighth month after the Effective Date, an amount equal to the greater of: (a) 25% of your Gross Sales, or (b) the applicable minimum monthly amounts shown in Note 3 following this table.

Marketing Fund Currently $100/month. An amount equal to the greater of: (a) one-half of one percent (0.5%) of the Card My Yard business' monthly Gross Sales or (b) $50 per month in the first 12 months of your agreement and $100 per month in each 12-month period thereafter.

Local Marketing and Cooperatives You must complete at least 24 promotional yard greeting services (worth a total of approximately $2,400) during each 12-month period under your agreement, and you must also spend at least the following amounts on local advertising: (a) $300 in the first 12 months of your agreement, (ii) $500 in months 13 through 24 of your agreement, and (iii) $800 in each 12-month period thereafter.

Interest and Late Fees Interest of 18% per annum or the maximum rate allowed by applicable law, or, at our option, $100 for each failure to timely pay an amount owed under the Franchise Agreement.

Additional Training at our offices At our option, a per diem rate of $150 a day for each trainer.
